paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。

paragraphs.paragraph_en: My research focuses on learning reliable representations and generative trajectories from non-stationary sequential data. While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Bridging non-stationary robustness and amplitude fidelity remains a core bottleneck in long-horizon forecasting. While instance normalization strips time-varying mean and variance shifts to stabilize attention weights, it simultaneously erases physical scale cues required to predict extreme load peaks. Conversely, retaining raw unnormalized inputs exposes self-attention layers to severe covariate shift, causing validation error to diverge over extended horizons. Resolving this tension requires a mechanism that disentangles intrinsic temporal dynamics from transient scale drift without discarding magnitude information.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: To resolve this dilemma, we propose DyTS-Net, a dual-stream forecasting architecture that decouples stationary structural modeling from dynamic scale trajectory estimation. Our key insight is that while high-frequency phase relationships benefit from normalized shift-invariant attention, macro-scale amplitude evolution follows a low-dimensional continuous dynamical system. Specifically, DyTS-Net first extracts scale-invariant temporal tokens via spectral patch attention, and concurrently models non-stationary mean-variance evolution through a lightweight neural ODE branch. Recombining both streams at the decoding stage preserves sharp peak magnitudes without sacrificing training stability.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Applying post-hoc gradient guidance during diffusion sampling often pushes intermediate noisy states off the data manifold, introducing unphysical high-frequency oscillations. To enforce physical boundary constraints without manifold deviation, we incorporate observation consistency directly into the conditional flow-matching velocity field. At flow time $\tau \in [0, 1]$, our network predicts a residual velocity $v_\theta(x_\tau, \tau \mid c)$ that projects the transport trajectory onto the null space of the linear constraint operator. This projection guarantees exact boundary satisfaction at terminal time $\tau=1$ while maintaining straight transport paths amenable to 4-step Euler integration.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 具身智能专属：多模态感知-动作闭环与 Sim-to-Real 阐述段（Embodied AI Policy）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想阐述具身智能机器人策略（Embodied Policy）如何融合视觉、本体感觉（Proprioception）或触觉，并克服仿真到真实硬件的动力学差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Visual Occlusion Bottleneck -> Asynchronous Multimodal Alignment -> Action Chunking -> Online Sim-to-Real System Identification. 绑定逻辑规则：L025, L003.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Relying solely on third-person RGB-D observations leaves visuomotor policies vulnerable to severe self-occlusion once the gripper approaches the target object. To preserve observability during contact-rich manipulation, our encoder aligns 30 Hz visual spatial tokens with 500 Hz joint proprioception and wrist force-torque histories via cross-modal rotary embeddings. Rather than issuing single-step commands prone to high-frequency jitter, the policy predicts 16-step SE(3) end-effector action chunks smoothed through exponential temporal ensembling. At deployment, a recurrent history adapter estimates latent surface friction and payload mass online, bridging the sim-to-real dynamics gap in zero shot.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写整篇小论文的 Conclusion：不简单复制粘贴 Abstract，而是从更高维度总结本文解决的科学矛盾、方法精髓、实证高度与领域启示。

paragraphs.paragraph_en: In this work, we resolved the long-standing tension between shift-invariant normalization and physical amplitude preservation in non-stationary time series forecasting. By decoupling frequency-domain phase attention from continuous neural-ODE scale tracking, DyTS-Net captures long-range seasonal dependencies while accurately reconstructing extreme peak magnitudes. Empirical evaluations across eight benchmarks and industrial wind-power telemetry demonstrated MSE reductions of up to 17.4% alongside a 45% reduction in computational overhead. Beyond forecasting, this structural-scale disentanglement principle provides a generalizable foundation for anomaly detection and closed-loop predictive control in non-stationary cyber-physical systems.
